-- STEP 1: query [kommuner]
SELECT ST_XMin(env) AS minx, ST_YMin(env) AS miny, ST_XMax(env) AS maxx, ST_YMax(env) AS maxy
FROM (
  SELECT ST_Envelope(omrade) AS env
  FROM kommuner_627ee106072240e99d2b21ec4717bf01.kommune
  WHERE upper(kommunenavn) = 'BERGEN'
) s;

-- STEP BOUNDARY --

-- STEP 2: query [matrikkelenbygning]
